Product Details: Portronics Titan 35 20000mAh Fast Charging Powerbank with in-Built Type C & 8 Pin Cable, 35W Super Fast Charging, Type C PD Output, Type C Bidirectional Port, LED Display (Black) - Distributed/Packaged by Portronics. Product Details: Portronics Titan 35 is a powerful and portable 20000mAh fast charging powerbank designed to keep your devices powered throughout the day. With up to 35W Type-C PD output, it delivers fast and efficient charging for smartphones, tablets, wireless earbuds, and other compatible gadgets. The built-in Type-C and 8-Pin charging cables eliminate the hassle of carrying separate cables, offering maximum convenience for both Android and iOS users. Equipped with advanced PPS charging technology, Titan 35 intelligently adjusts power delivery for faster, safer, and more optimized charging performance. The LED digital display accurately shows the remaining battery percentage, so you always know when it’s time to recharge. It also features multiple connectivity options including USB-A output and Type-C input/output for enhanced compatibility. Its sleek, compact, and travel-friendly design makes it easy to carry in bags, backpacks, or pockets, while the integrated cable loop adds portability and convenience. Whether you are travelling, working, gaming, attending meetings, or commuting daily, the Portronics Titan 35 ensures reliable backup power whenever you need it.
